title: More models, repaired routes
summary:
The model shelf grew while caching, traffic handling, and Pollen rewards got simpler and more precise.

ChatGPT 5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna were added with tools, reasoning, up to 10 reference images, and 1,050,000-token context windows. Seedream 5.0 Pro added image generation and editing with up to 10 reference images. Gemini Flash Lite and fast search were routed to Google's GA model after the preview retired; Flux Schnell's provider listing was corrected without changing its routing. The README caught up with the new models the next day.

User-tier progression and hourly Pollen refills were removed. Existing Quest and Paid Pollen balances remain intact, and generation still spends Quest Pollen first. `polli quests` now shows reward status and filters quests by open, claimable, claimed, or coming soon; claims still happen in the dashboard. App approval messages were also corrected to point contributors to the existing Contribute quest reward rather than tier benefits.

Vertex Gemini gained explicit context caching through `cache_control` markers on content blocks. Billing accounts for cache creation and its one-hour storage period while retaining discounted rates for cache hits. A guide covers caching across Gemini, Claude, and Nova, and the README now points to the Gemini addition.

Per-client rate limiting and abuse detection were changed to use each viewer's IP rather than a shared CDN address. An additional edge cap of 10,000 requests per 10 seconds was removed while the separate Pollen limiter remained. The gen API gateway's production edge rate-limiter binding was also restored.
